title: Australian visitor arrivals, first unpublished month
summary: Research task: predict whether short-term visitor arrivals to Australia fall below last year's same month - 27,131 country-months from the ABS OAD panel.

post.title: A retrospective direction task from Australia’s arrivals panel
paragraphs: The ABS releases arrivals statistics after their reference month. This task estimates the direction of the first unpublished month at the prior month’s release date. That target month may already have ended; this is not a next-calendar-month forecast issued before the month begins. Historical values come from a current revised snapshot, so exact as-of availability is assumed.

The question is a shortfall: will arrivals in the first unpublished month fall below the same month a year earlier. Positive rates run 35% / 29% / 20%, and the pandemic window is excluded rather than allowed to dominate.

Persistence is anti-correlated - repeating last year's direction scores 0.3647 - so this is mean-reversion and seasonality, not momentum. The runner-contract baseline reaches 0.6219 eval AUC, clearing the calendar-only rule at 0.5501 by 0.0718.

limitations: Derived from ABS OAD under CC BY 4.0 (attribution required); compilation CC0. Not an ABS product.
The pandemic window 2020-01..2021-12 is excluded by construction and counted, so crisis behaviour is not represented.
The source is revised monthly; a later rebuild will not reproduce these bytes.
The holdout is labelled and ships with the release; isolate it for blind evaluation.
Direction labels of this kind are dominated by seasonality in some series; per-series scores are not published.

No claim of real-time or operational forecasting validity: historical feature and label availability at the prediction instant is assumed from a current source snapshot, not verified against release vintages.

The labeled eval split is development/validation. Final holdout scoring requires prediction-time access restrictions; the original scorer provided the complete feature frame. Downloadable holdout labels must stay outside model development.
baseline_scope: One baseline through the runner's training and validation contract. No agent or harness comparison was run and none is implied.
